#
 sysname l3-q31
#
local-user admin class manage
 password simple Example-Secret-1
 service-type terminal ssh telnet
 authorization-attribute user-role network-admin
#
 stp global enable
 stp mode pvst
 port-security enable
#
vlan 10
 name sample-office
#
vlan 20
 name sample-voice
#
acl basic 2010
 rule 10 permit source 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127
#
acl advanced 3010
 rule 20 permit tcp source 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127 destination-port eq 80
 rule 20 comment sample office in
 rule 30 permit icmp icmp-type echo
 rule 35 deny ip
#
nqa entry track 1
 type icmp-echo
  destination ip 192.0.2.126
  frequency 5000
  reaction 1 checked-element probe-fail threshold-type consecutive 1 action-type trigger-only
#
 nqa schedule track 1 start-time now lifetime forever
 track 1 nqa entry track 1 reaction 1
#
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 description office desk
 port link-type access
 port access vlan 10
 voice-vlan 20 enable
 port-security max-mac-count 3
 port-security port-mode autolearn
 port-security intrusion-mode blockmac
#
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/24
 port link-type trunk
 undo port trunk permit vlan 1
 port trunk permit vlan 10 20
#
interface Vlan-interface10
 description sample office
 ip address 192.0.2.2 255.255.255.128
 packet-filter 3010 inbound
 vrrp version 3
 vrrp vrid 10 virtual-ip 192.0.2.1
 vrrp vrid 10 priority 120
 vrrp vrid 10 preempt-mode
 vrrp vrid 10 timer advertise 100
#
 ip route-static 0.0.0.0 0 192.0.2.126 track 1
#
 info-center loghost 192.0.2.20 facility local7
#
 snmp-agent
 snmp-agent community read example-ro acl 2010
 snmp-agent sys-info version v2c
#
 ntp-service enable
 ntp-service unicast-server 192.0.2.10
#
 header motd %sample notice: authorized use only%
#
line aux 0
 idle-timeout 5 30
#
 ssh server enable
 ssh server acl 2010
#
line vty 0 63
 authentication-mode scheme
 protocol inbound ssh
 idle-timeout 10
#
return
